guitar.notes: Randy Rhoads (early Quiet Riot, before Ozzy) is iconically associated with Gibson Les Paul/Jackson Concorde; "Cum On Feel The Noize" era was Carlos Cavazo on Jackson guitars.

tone.target: big 70s glam hard-rock crunch with bright upper mids
tone.profile: big 70s glam hard-rock crunch with bright upper mids
tone.summary: A crunchy, mid-focused signal chain using a Plexi-style amp model, Red Haze fuzz for bite, and a 4x12 cab to capture the classic 70s hard rock sound.
corrections: keep it crunchy, not high-gain modern
